thread:
Ben (AE): FYI OptiServe renewal coming up. They want to rebaseline to 10k tokens/day (was 3k) and ask for an "uplift" discount plus a custom DPA for government data. They're also asking to lock pricing for 24 months. Need deal-desk + legal + presales feedback.
Tara (Solutions Eng): Are they switching to high-memory models? They mentioned vector search spikes for reranking.
Priya (CSM): Confirmed: main load is chat + embeddings for rerank. Peak vectors ~150k/day but average lower. EU + US routing required.
Omar (Finance): Heads up: rate-card exceptions for 24mo locks need VP Finance sign-off. Floor pricing for embeddings is $0.60/1k vectors. Any below that triggers escalation.
Nina (Deal Desk): Please add numbers in the renewal template. We need target discount %, commit term, and whether infra fees (VPC, dedicated pool) apply. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/optiserve-renewal
Ben (AE): Pasted numbers. Proposal request: 35% off list for the uplift, 24mo lock, include EU residency and DPA at no extra charge.
Tara (Solutions Eng): Technical take: to support 10k tokens/day + vectors, recommend dedicated pool with autoscale and quantized weights. Ops estimate infra uplift ~$1.5k/month for EU endpoints and dedicated pool overhead.
Hannah (Legal): DPA: customized clauses for government data add 5-7 business days. Also need to check if their clause on subprocessor disclosure is acceptable.
InfraBot: InfraBot: EU capacity check: regional pool available, provisional quota reserved for OptiServe for 14 days.
Omar (Finance): If we absorb infra uplift and give 35% off for 24 months, margin becomes untenable. Finance prefers 20% + customer pays infra uplift, or 28% if 12mo term. Also prefer to tier discounts by commit volume.
Nina (Deal Desk): Creating approval packet. Option 1: 20% discount, 24mo, customer pays infra fees. Option 2: 28% discount, 12mo, infra included. Option 3: 32% discount, 24mo, but with minimum ARR guarantee (prepay). We need VP_Sales or CRO sign-off for anything >28% or where infra is absorbed.
Ben (AE): Customer insists on 24mo lock and no ops fees. They'll consider prepay if discount hits 32%.
Priya (CSM): From retention POV, 24mo lock is attractive but we need to ensure delivery timeline for EU endpoints + DPA. I can coordinate onboarding and timeline commitments.
Tara (Solutions Eng): Quick numbers: list run-rate for required config = $28k/mo. 35% off -> $18.2k/mo. Infra uplift $1.5k -> net $19.7k. 24mo prepaid would be ~$472.8k net.
Omar (Finance): Finance redline: we can approve Option 3 (32% + prepay) if they prepay at least 50% and we add a non-cancellable clause. Otherwise approve Option 2 only with 12mo.
Nina (Deal Desk): Marking escalation: need VP_Sales approval for Option 3 and Legal sign-off on DPA changes. Tagging @VP_Sales @Legal.
Hannah (Legal): I'll review DPA draft. If they insist on no subprocessors clause, we need exec buy-in; that is high risk.
Ben (AE): Chasing customer for willingness to prepay 50%. I'll update here.
InfraBot: InfraBot: Reserved quota expires in 14 days. Please confirm or release.
Priya (CSM): Also flagging support SLAs: they want a 4-hour P1 SLA in contract. That's an ops discussion.
Omar (Finance): 4-hour P1 SLA increases support costs. We can offer 8-hour SLA at list, 4-hour SLA as premium add-on.
Nina (Deal Desk): Updated packet with support SLA options and the three pricing options. If VP_Sales approves Option 3, forward to finance for executive sign-off.
Ben (AE): Customer responded: willing to prepay 50% if we include DPA and waive infra uplift. They want confirmation by EOB Wednesday.
Hannah (Legal): I'll prioritize DPA review. If we can't agree on subprocessors clause, propose a disclosure cadence instead.
Omar (Finance): OK tentatively greenlight Option 3 conditioned on prepay and Legal's DPA. @VP_Sales please confirm.
Nina (Deal Desk): Tagging for approval. If no reply by EOB, we'll push Option 2 as fallback.
Ben (AE): Thanks team. I'll push for signature and update the thread.
__notes: Single Slack thread string. Negotiation covers renewal uplift, rate-card exceptions, DPA/legal, prepay options, and deal-desk escalation.
